CustomField.description: Snapshot of Recurring_NS__c captured by workflow rule "Churned Account -- Recurring Rev Capture" when Status__c changes to Former. Represents recurring revenue lost at churn; excludes One_Time_NS__c (hardware/implementation). Blank when Recurring NS was already 0 at the status change (late or administrative churns). Not for manual entry.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set automatically when Status changes to Former - a snapshot of Recurring NS at the moment of churn (products only; excludes one-time hardware/implementation). Leave blank before churn; do not enter estimates.
CustomField.label: Churn Recurring Revenue
